summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on August 13, 2026, for a proposed offering of senior notes across four tranches. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction: AMD is issuing unsecured senior notes, with interest payable semi-annually, redeemable prior to maturity, and structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic reviews are present. The notes will not be listed on any exchange. Joint book-running managers include Barclays, BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo Securities. Terms are incomplete pending final pricing.
